quirks_resolved.body: ACLIDE Free includes €20 of internal usage credits renewed monthly with no payment card required. This is one account-wide allowance, not a separate grant per model or a cash token budget. These four routes passed text and function-call tests with matching returned model IDs. The native Responses adapter buffers streaming replies until completion. Vision and context limits are not claimed without route-specific verification. Matching response IDs do not independently authenticate the served weights. See https://aclide.com/en/pricing and https://aclide.com/en/documentation.
